Anchor: Tonight, a tanker that sits on three sanctions lists is still at sea. Our reporter has been following it.

Reporter: The tanker Tassos, IMO 9408695, used to sail as Front Balder. Records show it was flagged in Liberia, but today it flies a different flag.

Anchor: And there's a second ship?

Reporter: Yes. The vessel Meru, that's nine one eight seven two two seven, was reflagged last month. Sovcomflot PJSC declined to comment.
